resources.string: Maps, routes and search need your Mapbox public token. Create one at console.mapbox.com under Tokens and paste it here.
Only the active token is used. Tap another one to use it instead; the map then reloads.
Up to five tokens are stored, only on this phone. They are never built into the app and are excluded from backups and device transfers.
You can change the token after the trip ends.
The token is deleted from this phone.
The token is deleted from this phone. %1$s becomes the active token, and the map reloads.
The token is deleted from this phone. The map then needs a token again.
The map reloads, and then the map, routes and search use this token.
This is a secret token (sk.). Use a public token that starts with pk.
Mapbox public tokens start with pk.
This does not look like a complete Mapbox token.
This token is saved already, as %1$s.
Five tokens are saved. Delete one first.
This token is no longer saved.
Use a name such as Main or Test here, not the token.
Allow location access to see where you are and to plan routes.
Routes and turn-by-turn guidance need your precise location.
Location access is off for Custom Maps. Turn on precise location in its settings.
Simulated drive is on: the car moves along the route by itself. It still counts as a trip.

No internet. The map shows only areas saved on the phone; guidance continues.
Connected, but no internet. The map shows only saved areas.
Android is not letting Custom Maps use this network.
Light by day, dark at night, by the sun where the phone is. During a drive it waits until no turn is close.
Overview shows the rest of the route from above. The Overview button on the map switches it too.
Smoothest with the Smooth follow camera style.

In the Overview, the map comes down to each turn, exit and lane choice and goes back up when the next one is far enough away (about 1.25 miles). Off: the Overview stays up all the way. The tones sound either way.
After you move the map during a drive, it goes back by itself this long after your last touch, sooner when a turn is near. Off: only Recenter brings it back.
The Mapbox camera as it comes, for comparison
The same camera with calmer moves
Glides after the car on every frame
Applies at once, also during a drive.
With lanes drawn by the app, the close view shows the lit lane in the route line\'s place. In Mapbox tuned, and above about 75 mph, the route line stays over it instead, in the lane to take.
Large: close in before every turn and, on freeways, before exits and lane splits; back out after.
The Mapbox standard camera keeps its own zoom.
No lane lines on the map.
Lane markings, painted arrows and crosswalks where Mapbox has them: major highways and some cities. The route line stays thin close in.

On freeways where the route has lane data, the app draws the lanes with the route line in the lane to take. Close to an exit that lane is lit and the car is a bar across the road. Mapbox\'s lane details are off meanwhile.
The car shows where you are along the road, not which lane you are in. The lanes to use are in the card with every choice. The route line can hide under bridges.
Mapbox\'s electronic horizon, a beta. Mapbox may end its free use.
Soft chimes of the app\'s own. They follow the media volume.
One tone about 25 seconds before a turn, an exit, a lane choice or the destination.
Two tones about 7 seconds before it.
A little: a short dip. A podcast pauses for that moment; Off leaves it alone.
Against the music. The media volume sets the rest. A level chosen plays the one tone at it.
The one tone, then the two.
The media volume is at zero
Trip sessions this month: %1$d, since installation on %2$s
Trip sessions this month: %1$d, since %2$s, the oldest one kept
This build is signed with a temporary key. Installing the next CI build will need an uninstall, which deletes the token, the settings and this log: share the log first.
Counted on this phone each time guidance starts, simulated drives included. It is an estimate: Mapbox bills by its own count.
Every route with its roads and maneuvers, every second of guidance, searches and errors. It stays on this phone until you share it, for example to Google Drive. The Mapbox token is never in it.
The debug log could not be prepared for sharing.
All routes, drives and searches recorded on this phone are deleted.
Start replays the route instead of following GPS, for testing without driving. Each run counts as a trip.

With lanes drawn by the app, the drawing then shows at every other close view only, and each close view\'s frames go to the debug log, with Mapbox\'s lane details on under the drawing. The trip summary says whether the drawing kept the frames within budget.
Routes ask for the side roads\' access and form of way, to measure them. No request is added.

During guidance the app draws the route line itself, as Mapbox would, to compare the two; Mapbox\'s line comes back if the app\'s fails. With lanes drawn by the app the route line is the app\'s anyway.

How many frames a second the map on the car\'s screen draws, to compare 30 with 60 in the car. The car may show fewer than the map draws, since it shows the app\'s screen at a rate of its own, and 60 costs the phone more power and heat.

While the phone is hot, the map on the car\'s screen leaves out its 3D buildings, landmarks and trees, to draw less, and shows them again once the phone has been cooler for two minutes. The phone\'s own map keeps them. Off: the car\'s map always shows them.
Milliseconds of silence before a tone when nothing plays and a Bluetooth output is connected, so that an output asleep wakes before the tone starts.
Debug builds only. Ends the app at once with an error, as a crash would, to check that the crash and how the app ended are in the debug log.
Custom Maps closes at once, and guidance in progress stops. Open it again, then share the debug log.
